name: Broke Bibliophiles Bangalore: BBB Meetup #101 🎉
description:
Hello from another edition of the BBB Bulletin! 📚

📅 The 101st BBB MEETUP of 2026 IS HERE! :)

Sign up and join us for an evening of book discussions over hot coffee and biscuits - courtesy of the wonderful folks at The Bookworm, Church Street.

Use the RSVP link here:

https://forms.gle/rFMwMxbRDCJajoYF7

Once you RSVP, please send INR 120 to abhiram.ramesh@icici and mail us with your confirmation at brokebibliophilesbangalore@gmail.com .

If you fail to confirm your reservation by way of payment (and preferably the mail as well!) within 24 hours of RSVP-ing, your seat will be freed up to accommodate someone else who might want to register. This measure is to avoid last-minute cancellations which makes it difficult to re-fill those slots with people who might have wanted to attend.

📅 When? Sunday, 22nd Nov 2026| 3 PM – 6 PM

📍 Where? The Bookworm, Church Street

See you there!

For any queries, comment on this post or mail us at brokebibliophilesbangalore@gmail.com

We are also now re-active on Instagram thanks to Leah - one of our regulars and now our Insta Admin :) If you show up to the meetups, you can also have your reviews showcased on our Insta!

Here are some deets from our 100th meetup!
